entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: A substate of EMM-DEREGISTERED chosen when the UE knows that a selected cell cannot provide normal service due to various restrictions.

entities.name: Cell unable to provide normal service
entities.description: Condition where the selected cell is in a forbidden PLMN, forbidden tracking area, or is a CSG cell not in the UE's Allowed CSG list or Operator CSG List.

entities.name: UE knows cell restriction
entities.description: The UE is aware that the selected cell cannot provide normal service due to specific restrictions.

relations.description: The condition that a selected cell cannot provide normal service leads to the UE entering the EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state.
The UE's knowledge of the cell restriction is a guard condition for entering the EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state.
